decisions.statement: Every file the checkout has is counted.
A generated file is not counted.
A file type is the text following the last dot in a name.
A name with no dot is its own type.
A name whose only dot opens that name is its own type.
A file that could not be read is counted with no lines.
A file that could not be read is named under the total.
Types are ordered by how many lines each type has.
The total is every type counted rather than every path git listed.

definition: how many files of each type the checkout holds, and how many lines those files run to
